tasks.prompt: Identify regions with elevated delivery risk and sufficient order volume. Check whether your findings hold after excluding extreme values and changing the time range.
Compare delivery performance across two explicit periods. Examine whether differences may reflect date coverage or changes in business composition.
Investigate the association between low review scores and delivery problems using explicit reference groups. Check whether changing the score threshold or regional scope changes your findings.
Identify product categories with a high freight burden. Determine whether your findings hold under different statistical definitions.
Investigate how freight costs relate to product weight, volume, and price. Describe circumstances in which the observed relationships do not hold.
Identify sellers worth investigating within comparable business scopes. Check whether order volume or extreme orders affect your findings.
